	TRANSFER
Students will be able to independently use their learning to… Students will independently apply their understanding of volume, multiplication, and division to analyze, design, and solve real-world problems involving multi-digit whole numbers and 3-dimensional figures.
	UNDERSTANDING
Students will understand that…
• Volume is the measure of the space inside a three-dimensional figure, calculated using unit cubes or formulas.
• Multi-digit multiplication and division are related operations that can be modeled using place value and properties of operations.
• Mathematical problems involving area, volume, multiplication, and division arise in everyday contexts and require efficient computational strategies.
	ESSENTIAL QUESTIONS
Students will keep considering…
• How can we measure and compare the space inside three-dimensional figures?
• What strategies help us multiply and divide multi-digit numbers efficiently?
• How are multiplication and division related operations in real-world problem solving?

• How to pack rectangular prisms with unit cubes to find volume
• How to apply formulas V = l × w × h and V = B × h
• Place value strategies for multi-digit multiplication and division
• How to use partial quotients and standard algorithms
• Relationship between multiplication and division
	ACQUISITION — Students will be SKILLED AT…
• Finding volume using unit cubes and formulas

	UNDERSTANDING

• The base-ten number system extends to decimals, and place value understanding enables comparison, ordering, rounding, and computation.

• How does place value extend to decimals and help us compare and compute?
• What strategies make adding and subtracting fractions with unlike denominators manageable?

• Place value structure of decimals to thousandths

• Procedures for adding and subtracting decimals and fractions
	ACQUISITION — Students will be SKILLED AT…
• Reading, writing, comparing, and ordering decimals to thousandths
• Rounding decimals using place value understanding
• Adding and subtracting decimals using standard procedures

	UNDERSTANDING

	TRANSFER
Students will be able to independently use their learning to… Students will independently apply their understanding of volume, multiplication, and division to analyze, design, and solve real-world problems involving multi-digit whole numbers and 3-dimensional figures.
	UNDERSTANDING
Students will understand that…
• Volume is the measure of the space inside a three-dimensional figure, calculated using unit cubes or formulas.
• Multi-digit multiplication and division are related operations that can be modeled using place value and properties of operations.
• Mathematical problems involving area, volume, multiplication, and division arise in everyday contexts and require efficient computational strategies.
	ESSENTIAL QUESTIONS
Students will keep considering…
• How can we measure and compare the space inside three-dimensional figures?
• What strategies help us multiply and divide multi-digit numbers efficiently?
• How are multiplication and division related operations in real-world problem solving?
	ACQUISITION — Students will KNOW…
• How to pack rectangular prisms with unit cubes to find volume
• How to apply formulas V = l × w × h and V = B × h
• Place value strategies for multi-digit multiplication and division
• How to use partial quotients and standard algorithms
• Relationship between multiplication and division
	ACQUISITION — Students will be SKILLED AT…
• Finding volume using unit cubes and formulas
• Multiplying multi-digit numbers using place value strategies
• Dividing multi-digit numbers using partial quotients and algorithms
• Applying operations to solve real-world problems
• Communicating mathematical reasoning with precision
